QuestInfo.name: Yun's Worry 1
QuestInfo.0: After you finished Suri's Training, you discover that Yun wants to talk to you...
QuestInfo.1:
Yun's worried. As the investigation of the Dark Lord continues, Lady Syl seems to be getting more and more depressed. Yun wants to cheer her up. Head to the #bSwamp Region#k and get some #bPeaceful Violets#k for her.

#i3800279#


#i4033184##t4033184#  #b#c4033184#/10#k
QuestInfo.2: Yun expertly tied the flowers into a lovely bouquet.

0.0: Really? You're the best we can do? When I heard about the spy in Kerning City, I thought it'd be someone stupendous, but you're just a normal person. Oh well. I'll cross you off my list of heroes. Anyway, want to do me a favor?
0.1: Lady Syl is my number one hero, and she's been a little down since we've started investigating the Dark Lord. She never shows it, but I know anyway. I have astute observational abilities.
0.2: I'm also acutely insightful. All the shrinks say so. I know just what'll cheer her up. My insight also tells me that you're dying to help me.

yes.0: Lady Syl needs some #bPeaceful Violets#k, which you can find in the #bSwamp Region#k. I'll craft them into something you wouldn't believe, just wait and see.
yes.1:
And since you look especially doltish, I'd better show you what a Peaceful Violet looks like...

#i3800279#

Again, because I know you've already forgotten, you can find them in the Swamp Region.

no.0: That's it. I'm putting you on my list of people to eliminate when I'm older. Heehee!

1.0: Ah ha! You've got the flowers! MY turn! Watch and learn, my new friend. I will transform these into...a beautiful bouquet! Bet you didn't expect that!

item.0: You still haven't gone to the #bSwamp Region#k? I'm going to create a list of slowpokes, and you're going to the top of the list!
